body_html:
Having a wonderful meeting with @NHPS math teachers.

Excited to have @scsu pre-service teachers serve as remote mentors in math classes across the city,

We will have two days of paid teacher training (child crare credit available) and then have three students in remote classrooms.

The teacher covers a mini lesson and then remote menotrs support students in breakout rooms.

Going to be great for all involved.
